proposal:
Concrete correction:use a private str specialization of existing BuiltinCallable
and its existing BoundCallArguments/ArgumentPresence hooks. Keep builtin type
metadata/hierarchy per execution;unseal only that private base and expose its
constructor to the specialization. No new fields,public API,binder option or
memory layer. Validate only supplied codec-name types,distinguish omitted object
from None,and keep default None markers internal to existing codec parsers.
Remove Str/StrAsync array-length inference and the wrong positional-only flag.
Empty bytes skip codec lookup after type validation;decode borrows PyBytes.Memory,
removing its unadmitted input copy. Keep actual protocol awaits and native guards.

Tradeoff:the existing presence binder supplies three slots on general str calls,
so some zero/one-argument controls may allocate more. Measure one short allocation
comparison;do not expand the binder to optimize that tradeoff. Reuse builtin type/
new-slot/metadata tests and add alias/expanded keyword witnesses. Require the30
prepared regressions plus owner/protocol/codec/admission controls. Stop at str;
no changes to other builtin contracts,codec implementations or caller scopes.
